sentence: This project stores rat strains and embryonic stem cell lines and distributes them to biomedical researchers.
This project carries out research in medical genetics.
This project studies how RNA polymerase controls gene expression in different bacterial species.
This project studies pre-leukemic stem cells in patient samples and murine models and tests drugs that target them.
This project tests whether an immune response to foods, called food sensitization, raises the risk of cardiovascular disease.
This project studies the immune response to adenovirus infection in children.
This project studies how RNA gene control differs between cell types in human clinical samples of Alzheimer's disease.
This project adapts a program run by community health workers to support South Asians with type 2 diabetes who are at risk for depression.
This project tests a drug that blocks pyrimidine synthesis in patients with acute myeloid leukemia, together with decitabine.
This project builds mini-brain technology and drug delivery systems, using imaging and animal testing.
This project builds research strength in bioprinting and imaging methods for tissue engineering and drug validation.
This project studies how two variants of one gene change the risk of fatty liver disease.
This project uses Drosophila melanogaster to find genetic variants that affect cocaine preference and consumption.
This project studies how hormones control memory formation in the hippocampus through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
This project gets a mass spectrometry instrument to help researchers study molecular details across many biomedical research projects.
This project builds tools that measure and analyze movement to find what limits mobility and predict how treatments work.
This project builds a technology that finds the regulators controlling how DNA and RNA are arranged in space inside cells.
This project tests whether chromosomal instability predicts which patients respond to the chemotherapy drug paclitaxel.
This project builds ways to purify a protein and study its structure in fine detail using nanobodies and mass spectrometry.
This project studies how microplastic particles build up in the placenta during pregnancy and may add to preterm birth.
